map.BUR 过大（>5）型坯被拉得太薄、壁厚不均与穿孔风险骤增；过小（<2）则型坯过: A too large BUR (>5) stretches the parison too thin, so the wall thickness becomes uneven and the risk of pinholes spikes; too small (<2) makes the parision too thick, wastes material and makes it hard to conform to the mould wall. A BUR of 2~4 balances an even wall against material economy.

map.壁厚设计时，用制品壁厚=型坯壁厚÷BUR 推算实际壁厚与减薄率，避免吹薄穿孔或局: In wall thickness design, use product wall = parison wall / BUR to derive the actual wall and the thinning rate, avoiding blown-through pinholes or locally thick spots.
map.按环向应力平衡：吹胀压力 P 须使 2×σ_t×t/D ≤ 材料屈服，故最小 P: From hoop stress balance: the blow pressure P must keep 2 x sigma_t x t / D within the material yield, so the minimum P = 2 x sigma_t x t / D; multiply by a 1.5 safety factor for the recommended pressure, then convert to bar (x10) or psi (x145) to pick equipment.

map.瓶坯/容器吹塑工艺设计时，用吹胀比 BUR=制品直径÷型坯直径 评估壁厚均匀性（: In bottle preform / container blow molding design, use the blow-up ratio BUR = product diameter / preform diameter to assess wall thickness uniformity (2 to 4 is the suitable range).
map.设备选型时，用薄膜环向应力公式 最小吹胀压力=2×材料屈服强度×壁厚÷直径 反推: When selecting equipment, use the thin-film hoop stress formula minimum blow pressure = 2 x material yield strength x wall thickness / diameter to back out the compressor pressure requirement.
map.输入型坯直径、制品直径与吹胀压力等参数，工具计算吹胀比、壁厚分布与所需吹胀压力，: Enter the preform diameter, product diameter and blow pressure; the tool computes the blow-up ratio, wall thickness distribution and required blow pressure, and checks constraints such as the preform diameter having to exceed the product dimensions, supporting hollow blow molding process design and mold tuning.
map.：某瓶制品直径 100 mm、型坯直径 30 mm → 吹胀比 BUR = 10: : a bottle with product diameter 100 mm and preform diameter 30 mm gives BUR = 100/30 = 3.33 (suitable range 2 to 4); preform wall 4 mm / 3.33 gives a product wall of about 1.20 mm, a 70.0% thinning ratio. With material yield strength 30 MPa, product wall 1.2 mm and bottle diameter 80 mm, the theoretical minimum blow pressure = 2 x 30 x 1.2/80 = 0.90 MPa; applying a 1.5 safety factor gives about 1.35 MPa (about 13.5 bar).
